title: Money Function And Classification
definition: Money is any universally accepted medium of exchange that standardizes value, acts as a deferred payment standard, and stores wealth over time. Its classification ranges from commodity and fiat money to narrow and broad money aggregates.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding monetary aggregates (M1, M2, M3, M4), liquidity positions, and RBI's structural framework; highly relevant for Mains GS-3 (Indian Economy, Monetary Policy, and Inflation).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Money Function And Classification.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Barter System and Macroeconomics
